Method of Attack: Drops Cobalt Strike beacons and backdoors on Windows, Linux, and macOS systems
Executes setup.py script that detects host OS and fetches compatible malicious payload
For Linux, connects to remote URL at 39.107.154.72 and pipes output to bash shell (likely reverse shell)
For Windows and macOS, drops Cobalt Strike beacon providing remote access
Beacon enables command execution, keylogging, file actions, SOCKS proxying, privilege escalation, credential stealing, port scanning
Targets initial access to developer's internal network for lateral movement, data theft, further malware planting, or ransomware deployment
Attack Vector: Typosquatting on PyPI registry by mimicking PyKafka package name
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious package name 'pymafka' (typo-squatted variant of PyKafka)
Remote IP address 39.107.154.72 used for Linux payload delivery
Dropped executable on Windows at C:\Users\Public\iexplorer.exe (misspelled iexplore.exe)
